general.notes: L9-SC55311G-20PPC order row: 1550nm DFB Tx, PIN Rx, 0~70°C (Standard), 20 km, Simplex SC, 3.3 V, LVPECL TX/RX. Features also state up to 0.55 km on 62.5/125 μm MMF and up to 60 km on 9/125 μm SMF (product family). Launch optical power and receiver sensitivity/max input power rows are noted for 20 km. Operating case temperature Note 1: Standard 0 to +70°C; Note 2: Industrial -40°C to +85°C applies to other order codes (e.g. *PPI). Central wavelength table lists 1270–1350 nm (1310 FP) and 1510–1590 nm (1550 DFB); this SKU uses 1550 DFB. Receiver operating wavelength range 1260–1610 nm. Signal detect range -38 to -23 dBm. Data rate in recommended operating conditions: 10–1500 Mbps, typ 1250 Mbps. Supply current Icc max 260 mA (recommended) / Tx Icc max 250 mA; power in watts not stated.
general.suggestions: Clarify whether reach_km for this PN is only 20 km or also family maxima (60 km SMF). Map 1x9 pack to a canonical form_factor enum if required. Distinguish signal-detect thresholds from LOS assert/deassert if those MSA fields are needed.
